integrity_notes: The unrestricted assertions have direct row-column proofs; finite exhaustive graph checks are auxiliary and not a proof for all dimensions. No independent mathematical validation has been performed.
limitations: The theorem classifies minimum k-limited dominating sets of rook graphs with both sides at least two, not arbitrary Cartesian products or nonminimum sets. Two-row optimum distributions and numerical minima are previously covered and not claimed original. Computational checks are finite; bibliographic priority remains uncertain.
title: All minimum capacity-limited dominating sets of rook graphs
